description: Local development activation for dt-sdk run. Points at tools/local_cohesity_server.py, which serves the synthetic fixtures over HTTPS with a throwaway self-signed certificate - hence verifyTls false. Set fixtureDir instead of host to replay the same fixtures without a socket. AUTH: this file uses the inline mode ('useCredentialVault': false, 'apiKey' set), which is the only mode that works locally - there is no EEC here to resolve a vault entry, so selecting one would simply produce an empty credential. The vault shape is recorded below for reference only; see credentialVaultExample.

credentialVaultExample.comment: NOT READ BY THE EXTENSION. This is what one endpoint looks like once the ActiveGate has resolved a credential vault entry and injected it. Note the trap: the extension never sees 'credentialVaultId' carrying a secret - the EEC substitutes the resolved value into a DIFFERENT field, and which field that is is undocumented for referencedType TOKEN. cohesity_storage.config.VAULT_SECRET_FIELDS probes token, then password, then apiKey and takes the first non-empty, which is why this example shows 'token' but the code does not depend on it.

endpoint.name: cohesity-prod
endpoint.token: <injected by the EEC from the vault entry - never typed here>
